name: Boot Online Guide for AI
description: A map for AI to understand the boot_online system, file relationships, and auto-build process.

overview.title: What is this folder?
overview.content: boot_online/ is the entry point for external AI (DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, Grok) into Mandala Symbiosis. It contains the onboarding files and the auto-build system that keeps them up to date.

items.index.json: Core onboarding logic: steps, rules, roles, self-learning system. Source of truth for onboarding.
items.boot_online_onboarding_pc_builder.json: Master config for the auto-builder. Defines which source modules are embedded and how the final file is built.
items.boot_online_onboarding_pc.json: Final, auto-built file — the complete onboarding package for External SR. Do not edit manually. It is overwritten by GitHub Actions.
items.builder/: Folder containing the build_onboarding.py script that assembles the final file.
items.GUIDE.json: This file. A map for AI to understand the system.

relationships.title: File relationships
flow: boot_online_onboarding_pc_builder.json (defines what to embed and how)

auto_build.title: How the auto-build works
auto_build.trigger: GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/build-onboarding.yml) runs on push to main that changes files in honeycombs/boot_online/ or honeycombs/scripts/, or manually via GitHub UI.
script_actions: Reads boot_online_onboarding_pc_builder.json to know which source modules to embed.
Fetches content from those modules (e.g., core_map/index.json, philosophy/index.json).
Assembles the final boot_online_onboarding_pc.json with all embedded content.
auto_build.output: The generated file is committed and pushed back to the repository.

how_to_use.title: How AI should use these files

onboarding.description: When onboarding a new External SR:
steps: Read index.json first — it contains the step-by-step onboarding procedure.
Follow the onboarding_procedure — AI leads the Gardener through each step.
Use boot_online_onboarding_pc.json only if you need the all-in-one file (e.g., for quick copy-paste into a chat).
Do NOT edit boot_online_onboarding_pc.json directly — it will be overwritten.
Edit the source modules (e.g., core_map/index.json, philosophy/index.json, instructions/...).
Update boot_online_onboarding_pc_builder.json if you need to change which modules are embedded or how they are structured.
Push changes — the auto-build will regenerate the final file.
Check builder/build_onboarding.py — this is the assembly logic.
Check .github/workflows/build-onboarding.yml — this is the automation trigger.

principles.title: Principles for AI
rules: Always fetch current versions via API — never assume local state.
Never patch without API pre-check — violation = resonance break.
After patch, request updated file via API — confirm SHA and version before reporting success.
Follow the onboarding procedure — AI leads, Gardener follows.
Use copyable links — wrap URLs in ```text blocks.
Be concise — schematic, laconic, structure-only responses.

migration_note.title: Migration note (2026-07-08)
migration_note.content: The system now uses a unified works/ folder instead of separate tasks/ and roadmaps/.
details: All work items (tasks and roadmaps) live in honeycombs/works/.
Each work file has a horizon field: 'strategic' (roadmap) or 'tactical' (task).
The builder config (boot_online_onboarding_pc_builder.json) has been updated to reference works/.
If you see references to tasks/ or roadmaps/ in older files, they should be updated to works/.
